modules.name: python/sglang/cli
modules.role: Primary user entry commands (`sglang serve|generate|version`); dispatches into LLM runtime or diffusion runtime paths.

modules.name: python/sglang/launch_server.py
modules.role: LLM-serving launcher that selects HTTP, gRPC, Ray, or encoder-only disaggregation startup modes.

modules.name: python/sglang/lang
modules.role: Frontend DSL/runtime client API layer (`Runtime`, `Engine`, generation primitives) exposed from package root.

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/entrypoints
modules.role: SRT server surface (FastAPI HTTP, gRPC server, OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama adapters, engine bootstrap, warmup).

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/managers
modules.role: Runtime orchestration managers for tokenization, scheduling, templates, request structs, and process coordination.

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/model_executor
modules.role: Model execution backend used by scheduler/runtime to run inference steps on loaded model weights.

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/layers
modules.role: Core inference layers (attention, MoE, quantization, activations, normalization, samplers).

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/mem_cache
modules.role: KV cache memory pools and host/device cache management for throughput and long-context reuse.

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/disaggregation
modules.role: Prefill/decode disaggregation modes and utilities (including encoder-side serving flows).

modules.name: python/sglang/srt/grpc
modules.role: gRPC request management, scheduler launcher bridge, and health/rpc utilities for SRT serving.

modules.name: python/sglang/multimodal_gen
modules.role: Diffusion and multimodal generation runtime with separate serve path selected by CLI model-type logic.

modules.name: sgl-kernel/python/sgl_kernel
modules.role: Python package exposing precompiled/custom ops (attention, quantization, MoE, cache, sampling kernels).

modules.name: sgl-kernel/csrc
modules.role: C++/CUDA/HIP kernel implementation source compiled into `sgl_kernel` extension modules.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/main.rs
modules.role: Gateway CLI binary entry (`sgl-model-gateway`/`smg`/`amg`) parsing launch config for routing mode/policies/discovery.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/server
modules.role: Axum server endpoints and request handlers exposing OpenAI-compatible APIs, worker admin, parse/tokenize, health.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/routers
modules.role: Router implementations and `RouterManager` for HTTP/gRPC/PD/OpenAI routing with model-aware selection.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/core
modules.role: Gateway core worker abstractions, registry/hash ring, queue, retry/circuit-breaker and workflow primitives.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/policies
modules.role: Load-balancing policy implementations (cache-aware, power-of-two, prefix hash, manual, round robin, random).

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/config
modules.role: Typed configuration builder/validation and routing mode definitions consumed by startup/server components.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/service_discovery
modules.role: Kubernetes pod watcher/discovery that updates worker/router topology for regular and PD deployments.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/observability
modules.role: Metrics/logging/OpenTelemetry instrumentation attached to gateway server and worker/routing lifecycle.

modules.name: sgl-model-gateway/src/wasm
modules.role: WASM extension route support for request-time custom logic modules registered through gateway APIs.

relations.reason: `cli/serve.py` imports `run_server` from `sglang.launch_server` for standard LLM serving path.
`cli/serve.py` dispatches to `multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints.cli.serve` when model is diffusion.
Launch path selects `srt.entrypoints.http_server.launch_server` or `srt.entrypoints.grpc_server.serve_grpc`.
Encoder-only mode imports `srt.disaggregation.encode_server` / `encode_grpc_server`.
`lang/api.py` lazily exposes runtime `Engine` by importing `sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine`.
`entrypoints/http_server.py` imports tokenizer/template/io_struct and multi-tokenizer manager modules.
`entrypoints/grpc_server.py` imports grpc request manager, health servicer, and scheduler launcher.
HTTP/gRPC entrypoints use disaggregation utilities and KV-event helpers for PD mode.
Engine bootstrap starts scheduler/executor pipeline that delegates batch inference to model executor stack.
Model execution relies on layer primitives for attention, quantization, MoE routing, and sampling operations.
Multiple layer modules import `sgl_kernel` ops (e.g., flash attention, quant kernels, MoE helpers).
`mem_cache/memory_pool_host.py` imports `sgl_kernel.kvcacheio` transfer kernels.
`sgl_kernel/__init__.py` loads architecture-specific compiled ops produced from `sgl-kernel/csrc`.
Disaggregation services interact with manager-layer request structures and runtime services for PD workflows.
Serving runtime uses cache/prefix memory layers to warmup, reuse KV state, and manage throughput.
`main.rs` imports config types/builders (`RouterConfig`, retry, breaker, metrics, discovery settings).
CLI launch eventually constructs `ServerConfig` and starts gateway server runtime.
Server handlers delegate route requests (`chat/completions/embeddings/responses/...`) to router trait/manager.
Server owns worker manager, job queue, worker registry, and workflow engines from core module.
Server starts Kubernetes discovery loop (`start_service_discovery`) to maintain worker topology.
Server wires logging, Prometheus metrics, and OTEL tracing middleware/components.
Server registers wasm endpoints (`add/remove/list_wasm_module`) for runtime extension hooks.
Routers and `RouterManager` use worker registry/runtime type/connection mode from core abstractions.
Router factory and route selection rely on policy implementations for balancing and model routing decisions.
Router identity selection and mode branching use `RoutingMode` and connection config types.
Discovery watcher creates worker registration jobs and updates registry state as pod status changes.
Policy scoring/selection uses worker metadata/load/registry primitives from core module.
Config includes routing and connection settings that map into core worker/runtime types.
Observability layer records worker/router/core events and exports runtime metrics for those components.
